summary: 100-foot steel fire tower near Round Lake, Sawyer County, WI; built 1936 per state record and Forest Lookouts; listed as standing; no staffing or access information found.

facts.design: 100-foot steel observation and fire tower with a steel frame (state record: observation/fire tower, steel frame)
facts.agency: Chequamegan National Forest, spelling as in the Forest Lookouts source

notes_for_editor: Sources agree on 1936 and 100 feet. The Forest Lookouts page spells the forest 'Chequamegan'; the brief copied that spelling, so confirm the forest's correct name before publishing. No staffing, fire or access information was found in the pages read. An OpenStreetMap node (353893853, ele 455, tower:type observation) was checked and could support elevation if needed, but it is not cited. Search results listed Wisconsin Historical Society photo assets for the tower and a tower cabin; they were not opened, so no photos are listed.
